name: Morna Root-Eater
source_profile: ● Morna Root-Eater (N) is an elderly giant who remembers longstanding agreements between certain Broadmaw families and the Varkesh orcs. Morna considers Grudda's constant raiding wasteful and dangerous.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 59 (source excerpt; may be partial)
